title: Velvety Umami Xiaolongbao Tunisian Rocket Tagine
description: Romantic, flavorful dish featuring xiaolongbao, rocket, and Tunisian spices, cooked in a comal vessel and served with a side of velvety rice dish, khao khua.

ingredients.name: Khao Khua Rice
ingredients.notes: +mix of deep fried and ground rice

instructions: Combine rice and 2 cups of water in a medium saucepan and cook over high heat until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender, about 15 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat and cook the ground pork and mushroom duxelles until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the cumin powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes to the pan and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lemon juice and fish sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the xiaolongbao according to package instructions, about 10-12 minutes.
While the xiaolongbao is cooking, heat a comal vessel over medium heat and add a small amount of olive oil to the bottom of the vessel.
Using a slotted spoon, carefully place the cooked xiaolongbao into the comal vessel, leaving a small amount of space between each piece.
Brush the tops of the xiaolongbao with the egg wash and cover the vessel with a lid to trap the steam.
Cook the xiaolongbao for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the tops are golden brown and the dumplings are cooked through.
To serve, place a few pieces of xiaolongbao onto a plate and serve with a side of khao khua and a sprinkle of sesame oil and chopped rocket leaves.
